en.one: An aluminium sheet and foil processor paid a processing fee; weak moat, fails the criterion. About a third of trailing profit is one-off.
en.business: Yong Jie turns aluminium ingot into sheet, strip and foil and sells it. The price is the ingot price plus a processing fee; the fee is what the company earns. In the first nine months of 2026 revenue was 10.09 billion yuan; 85.4% came from sheet and strip and 12.3% from foil. According to the IPO prospectus, 42.1% of revenue in the first half of 2024 came from lithium battery customers and 27.1% from electronics. In June 2026 it bought Arconic's two plants in China (Qinhuangdao and Kunshan); capacity rose from 485 thousand to 735 thousand tonnes.
en.moat_text: The moat is weak. There is an edge: a certificate from the China Nonferrous Metals Processing Association says the company ranked first in China in aluminium strip for lithium battery casings in 2021-2023, and real return on equity did not fall below 17% in any of the five years (17.12% in 2025, 21.03% in 2024). But this is a processing business and pricing power does not show in the margin. Gross margin was 9.46% in 2021, 9.77% in 2022 and 8.94% in 2023; it was 8.53% in the first nine months of 2026 and 7.66% in the third quarter. The company's output was 1.72% of the industry in 2023; many rivals make the same product and the customers are large battery makers. The 23.5% real return on equity of the last twelve months is inflated by a one-off gain: the company's own profit excluding non-recurring items was 513 million yuan over the last twelve months, against reported profit of 757 million yuan. That is why the moat is not rated narrow.
en.mgmt: The company is controlled by Shen Jianguo and his wife Wang Xushu: at the end of 2025 Zhejiang Yongjie Holding held 35.89% and Shen Jianguo 15.38%. It listed in Shanghai on 11 March 2025; 49.2 million new shares were sold at 20.60 yuan, bringing in a net 931.9 million yuan. Equity attributable to shareholders rose from 1.68 billion yuan at the end of 2024 to 2.92 billion yuan at the end of 2025; that is why return on equity fell. 30.08% of 2025 profit was paid as dividends (6.35 yuan per 10 shares); the 2026 interim dividend is 5.19 yuan per 10 shares. The biggest capital decision is the June 2026 acquisition: about 1.22 billion yuan in cash, paid with a 1.1 billion yuan acquisition loan and 256 million yuan of IPO proceeds; a lithium battery strip investment project was cancelled for it. The purchase is inside the core business and was not paid in shares. The targets' net assets at the end of 2025 (1.03 billion and 0.59 billion yuan) were above the price. In June 2026, 1.415 million restricted shares were granted to 67 employees (0.7% of the share capital); the plan's expense is not in the documents read. The pre-IPO Qianhai funds (7.97%) are selling shares. Buybacks: checked, not in the documents. Goodwill, derivative positions and guarantees given: checked, not in the documents read; the full text of the 2026 interim and third-quarter reports could not be opened.
en.latest: 28 October 2026: The company published its third-quarter report. Nine-month revenue rose 43.69% to 10.09 billion yuan and net profit attributable to shareholders rose 110.83% to 651 million yuan. Profit excluding non-recurring items rose 28.17% to 395 million yuan; the 256 million yuan gap was booked in the second quarter with the consolidation of the acquisition completed in June. In the third quarter revenue rose 87.46% to 4.86 billion yuan, net profit rose 11.23% to 137 million yuan and profit excluding non-recurring items rose 23.54% to 148 million yuan. Third-quarter gross margin fell 1.93 points to 7.66%; finance costs rose because of the loan.
risks: The profit of the last twelve months does not show normal earning power: about 244 million yuan (32%) of the 757 million yuan profit comes from the company's own non-recurring items; most was booked with the consolidation of the acquisition and will not recur.
The company passes the aluminium price on to customers, but the processing fee is set by competition; gross margin is thin at around 9% and fell to 7.66% in the third quarter.

The acquisition enlarged the company by half at a stroke: the two plants had 2025 revenue of 5.74 billion yuan, 59.5% of the company's revenue. Qinhuangdao lost 97.9 million yuan in 2024 and its leases on land, buildings and machinery are close to expiry.
Debt has risen: a 1.1 billion yuan loan was taken for the acquisition. The source's net debt/EBITDA is 0.44; the source's free cash flow data covers only the last two periods.

Demand depends on the lithium battery, electronics and automotive cycle; the five-year record covers a period of fast-growing battery demand and does not show a full cycle. Exports are 20-40% of the acquired plants' revenue and are exposed to tariff decisions.

601838.one: Chengdu'nun şehir bankası. Özsermaye kârlılığı yüksek görünüyor ama aktif kârlılığı %1'in altına indi: kazanç kaldıraçtan geliyor. Kalite surunda kaldı.
601838.business: Bank of Chengdu, Çin'in Chengdu şehrinde kurulu bir ticari bankadır. Mevduat toplar, kredi verir; gelirinin çoğu faizden gelir. 2026'nın ilk dokuz ayında 19,51 milyar yuan gelirin 17,91 milyar yuanı net faiz geliriydi. Eylül 2026 sonunda varlıkları yaklaşık 1,50 trilyon yuan, mevduatı 1,07 trilyon yuan, kredileri 897,9 milyar yuandı.
601838.moat_text: Hendek dar. Banka lisansı, 1,07 trilyon yuanlık mevduat tabanı ve şehrin yatırım şirketinin en büyük ortak olması gerçek bir üstünlük sağlıyor. Kanıt rakamlarda: takipteki kredi oranı %0,68, karşılık oranı %448,06. Reel özsermaye kârlılığı beş yıldır %13 ile %18 arasında. Zayıf yanı: iş tek bir şehre ve bölgeye bağlı. Reel özsermaye kârlılığı 2023'teki %17,87'den son 12 ayda %12,52'ye indi. Yakın izlemedeki krediler yıl başındaki 2,93 milyar yuandan 4,49 milyar yuana çıktı.
601838.mgmt: En büyük ortak Chengdu'nun finans holdingi Jiaozi Financial Holdings'tir (%19,999). İkinci ortak Hong Leong Bank'tır (%17,779). Hâkim tek ortak yok, ama belediye sermayesinin ağırlığı büyük. Banka 2026'da ilk kez ara temettü verdi: 10 hisseye 4,89 yuan, toplam 2,07 milyar yuan, ilk yarı kârının %30,02'si. Son üç yılda dağıtım oranı en az %30 oldu. Kalan kâr sermayede kalıyor, çünkü çekirdek sermaye oranı %8,85 ile yüksek değil. Pay sayısı 2022'den bu yana %17,3 arttı: 8 milyar yuanlık dönüştürülebilir tahvil hisseye çevrildi (2024'te 356 milyon, 2025'te 68,5 milyon hisse). Banka hisse geri almıyor; sermayesini hisse ihracıyla ve sürekli tahvillerle güçlendiriyor. Chengdu belediyesine bağlı üç ortak birlikte payların %30,82'sini tutuyor.
601838.latest: 28 Ekim 2026: Banka dokuz aylık sonuçlarını açıkladı. Gelir %9,84 artışla 19,51 milyar yuan, ana ortaklık net kârı %4,48 artışla 9,92 milyar yuan oldu. Üçüncü çeyrekte gelir %22,59 arttı, ama faaliyet kârı %0,72 geriledi. Kredi değer düşüklüğü gideri %82,52 artarak 3,30 milyar yuana çıktı. Takipteki kredi oranı %0,68'de kaldı. Çekirdek sermaye oranı %8,85, toplam sermaye yeterliliği %13,57.
risks: Güvenlik marjını zayıflatan gelişme şu: kâr artışı %4,48'e indi, üçüncü çeyrekte faaliyet kârı geriledi ve reel özsermaye kârlılığı son 12 ayda %12,52'ye düştü.

Kredi yoğunlaşması yüksek: kredilerin %72,7'si Chengdu'da; kurumsal kredilerin %48,08'i kiralama ve iş hizmetlerine, %14,64'ü su, çevre ve kamu tesislerine gidiyor (2025). Bu iki alan çoğunlukla yerel yönetimlerin yatırım şirketleridir; yerel kamu borcunda bir sorun bankayı doğrudan etkiler.
Varlık kârlılığı üç yıldır düşüyor: 2023'te %1,16, 2025'te %1,00, 2026'nın dokuz ayında yıllık %0,91. Vadesi geçmiş krediler 2025'te %38 arttı.
Karşılık gideri dokuz ayda %82,52 arttı ve yakın izlemedeki krediler 4,49 milyar yuana çıktı; kredi kalitesi bozulursa kâr daha da düşer.
Banka tek bir şehre ve bölgeye bağlıdır; Chengdu ekonomisinde ya da yerel kamu borçlarında bir sorun doğrudan bilançoya yansır.

en.one: Chengdu's city bank. Return on equity looks high, but return on assets has fallen below 1%: the earnings come from leverage. It stays at the quality wall.
en.business: Bank of Chengdu is a commercial bank based in the Chinese city of Chengdu. It takes deposits and makes loans; most of its income is interest. In the first nine months of 2026, 17.91 billion yuan of its 19.51 billion yuan revenue was net interest income. At the end of September 2026 it had about 1.50 trillion yuan of assets, 1.07 trillion yuan of deposits and 897.9 billion yuan of loans.
en.moat_text: The moat is narrow. The banking licence, a deposit base of 1.07 trillion yuan and the city's investment company as largest shareholder give a real edge. The numbers show it: the bad-loan ratio is 0.68% and provision coverage is 448.06%. Real return on equity has stayed between 13% and 18% for five years. The weak side: the business depends on one city and region. Real return on equity fell from 17.87% in 2023 to 12.52% over the last twelve months. Special-mention loans rose from 2.93 billion yuan at the start of the year to 4.49 billion yuan.
en.mgmt: The largest shareholder is Jiaozi Financial Holdings, Chengdu's financial holding company (19.999%). The second is Hong Leong Bank (17.779%). No single shareholder has control, but municipal capital carries great weight. In 2026 the bank paid its first interim dividend: 4.89 yuan per 10 shares, 2.07 billion yuan in total, 30.02% of first-half profit. The payout ratio has been at least 30% for the last three years. The rest of the profit stays in capital, because the core capital ratio is not high at 8.85%. The share count has risen 17.3% since 2022: an RMB 8 billion convertible bond turned into shares (356 million shares in 2024, 68.5 million in 2025). The bank does not buy back shares; it builds capital through share issuance and perpetual bonds. Three shareholders controlled by the Chengdu city government together hold 30.82%.
en.latest: 28 October 2026: The bank reported nine-month results. Revenue rose 9.84% to 19.51 billion yuan and net profit attributable to shareholders rose 4.48% to 9.92 billion yuan. In the third quarter revenue rose 22.59%, but operating profit fell 0.72%. Credit impairment charges rose 82.52% to 3.30 billion yuan. The bad-loan ratio stayed at 0.68%. The core tier 1 ratio is 8.85% and the total capital ratio is 13.57%.
risks: What weakens the margin of safety: profit growth slowed to 4.48%, operating profit fell in the third quarter and real return on equity dropped to 12.52% over the last twelve months.

Lending is concentrated: 72.7% of loans are in Chengdu; 48.08% of corporate loans go to leasing and business services and 14.64% to water, environment and public facilities (2025). These are mostly local-government investment companies; a problem in local public debt hits the bank directly.
Return on assets has fallen for three years: 1.16% in 2023, 1.00% in 2025 and 0.91% annualised in the first nine months of 2026. Overdue loans rose 38% in 2025.
Impairment charges rose 82.52% in nine months and special-mention loans climbed to 4.49 billion yuan; if credit quality worsens, profit falls further.
The bank depends on one city and region; trouble in Chengdu's economy or in local public debt would show up directly on its balance sheet.

002475.one: Telefon, kulaklık, veri merkezi ve otomobil için parça üreten ve cihaz monte eden fason üretici. Marjı ince, borcu artıyor; hendek ölçütünü geçemedi.
002475.business: Luxshare, başka markalar için bağlantı parçaları, kablolar ve modüller üretir, telefon ve kulaklık gibi cihazları monte eder. 2026'nın ilk yarısında 174,50 milyar yuan gelirin 122,48 milyar yuanı tüketici elektroniğinden, 32,39 milyar yuanı otomotiv elektroniğinden, 16,61 milyar yuanı iletişim ve veri merkezi ürünlerinden geldi. Para, büyük hacimli üretimden alınan ince bir paydan kazanılır: 2025'te brüt kâr marjı %11,9 oldu.
002475.moat_text: Hendek zayıf. Üstünlük var: ölçek, hassas üretim becerisi ve büyük müşterilerle uzun ilişki. Ama iş fason üretimdir; tasarım ve marka müşterinindir, fiyatı da müşteri belirler. Marj bunu gösteriyor: 2026'nın ilk yarısında brüt kâr marjı %11,78; tüketici elektroniğinde %10,25. Dokuz ayda 285,01 milyar yuan gelire karşılık ana ortaklık net kârı 13,06 milyar yuan, yani yaklaşık %4,6. Gelir %29,01 artarken kâr %13,36 arttı: büyüme kârlılığı aşağı çekiyor. Reel özsermaye kârlılığı beş yıl boyunca %17,91 ile %19,26 arasında kaldıktan sonra son 12 ayda %15,55'e indi. B puanı 1 olduğu için şirket 3. suru geçemedi.
002475.mgmt: Hâkim ortak Luxshare Limited'dir (%37,32). Yönetim kurulu başkanı Wang Laichun'dur. Kârın çoğu şirkette kalıyor: dağıtım oranı %21,88, temettü verimi %0,27. 2026'da üç kez temettü dağıtıldı, toplam 1,77 milyar yuan; geri alıma yaklaşık 1 milyar yuan harcandı. Para büyümeye ve satın almalara gidiyor: Alman otomotiv kablo üreticisi Leoni ve Wingtech'in fason tasarım (ODM) varlıkları. Borç yüksek: borç/varlık oranı Haziran 2026'da %67,44, net borç/FAVÖK 2,23. Dokuz ayda finansman gideri 3,22 milyar yuan oldu. 2026'nın ilk yarısında faaliyet nakit akışı eksi 2,45 milyar yuandı.
002475.latest: 29 Ekim 2026: Şirket dokuz aylık sonuçlarını açıkladı. Gelir %29,01 artışla 285,01 milyar yuan, ana ortaklık net kârı %13,36 artışla 13,06 milyar yuan oldu; bu, şirketin Ağustos'ta verdiği 13,25-14,40 milyar yuanlık tahmin aralığının altında. Üçüncü çeyrekte gelir %14,62 artışla 110,51 milyar yuan, net kâr %6,98 artışla 5,21 milyar yuan. Şirket 2026 yılı için 19,09-19,92 milyar yuan net kâr bekliyor (%15-20 artış).
risks: Gelirin yaklaşık %70'i tüketici elektroniğinden gelir ve az sayıda büyük müşteriye bağlıdır; bir müşterinin siparişi başka üreticiye kaydırması kârı doğrudan düşürür.
Marj incedir (dokuz ayda net kâr gelirin yaklaşık %4,6'sı); maliyet artışı ya da kur zararı kârı hızla eritir. 2026'nın ilk yarısında yaklaşık 1,99 milyar yuan kur zararı yazıldı.
Borç artıyor: net borç/FAVÖK 2,23 ile 2. surun eşiğine (3,0) yaklaşıyor; serbest nakit akışı son 12 ayda eksi.
Leoni ve Wingtech varlıkları gibi büyük satın almaların beklenen kârı getirmesi kesin değil.
Gümrük vergileri ve ticaret kısıtları, üretimin yerini ve maliyetini değiştirebilir.

en.one: Contract manufacturer of parts and devices for phones, earphones, data centres and cars. Thin margins, rising debt; it did not pass.
en.business: Luxshare makes connectors, cables and modules for other brands and assembles devices such as phones and earphones. In the first half of 2026, 122.48 billion yuan of its 174.50 billion yuan revenue came from consumer electronics, 32.39 billion yuan from automotive electronics and 16.61 billion yuan from communications and data centre products. It earns a thin slice of a large production volume: gross margin was 11.9% in 2025.
en.moat_text: The moat is weak. There is an advantage: scale, precision manufacturing skill and long relationships with large customers. But this is contract manufacturing; the design and the brand belong to the customer, and the customer sets the price. The margin shows it: gross margin was 11.78% in the first half of 2026 and 10.25% in consumer electronics. In nine months net profit attributable to shareholders was 13.06 billion yuan on revenue of 285.01 billion yuan, about 4.6%. Revenue rose 29.01% while profit rose 13.36%: growth is pulling profitability down. Real return on equity stayed between 17.91% and 19.26% for five years and then fell to 15.55% over the last twelve months. With a B score of 1, the company did not pass Wall 3.
en.mgmt: The controlling shareholder is Luxshare Limited (37.32%). The board is chaired by Wang Laichun. Most of the profit stays in the company: the payout ratio is 21.88% and the dividend yield 0.27%. Dividends were paid three times in 2026, 1.77 billion yuan in total; about 1 billion yuan was spent on buybacks. The money goes to growth and acquisitions: German automotive cable maker Leoni and Wingtech's contract design (ODM) assets. Debt is high: the debt-to-asset ratio was 67.44% in June 2026 and net debt/EBITDA is 2.23. Finance costs were 3.22 billion yuan in nine months. Operating cash flow was minus 2.45 billion yuan in the first half of 2026.
en.latest: 29 October 2026: The company reported nine-month results. Revenue rose 29.01% to 285.01 billion yuan and net profit attributable to shareholders rose 13.36% to 13.06 billion yuan; this is below the 13.25-14.40 billion yuan range the company estimated in August. In the third quarter revenue rose 14.62% to 110.51 billion yuan and net profit rose 6.98% to 5.21 billion yuan. The company expects net profit of 19.09-19.92 billion yuan for 2026 (up 15-20%).
risks: About 70% of revenue comes from consumer electronics and depends on a small number of large customers; if a customer moves orders to another manufacturer, profit falls directly.

The margin is thin (nine-month net profit is about 4.6% of revenue); higher costs or currency losses erode profit quickly. A currency loss of about 1.99 billion yuan was booked in the first half of 2026.
Debt is rising: at 2.23, net debt/EBITDA is approaching the Wall 2 threshold (3.0); free cash flow is negative over the last twelve months.
It is not certain that large acquisitions such as Leoni and the Wingtech assets will deliver the expected profit.
Tariffs and trade restrictions can change where production takes place and what it costs.
